artworks.title: Fishermen at the Tiber, near the Soracte
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a river running through hilly terrain. The horizon is at the top, bordered by mountains that merge with the sky. A rocky hillside with trees and vegetation is on the left, creating depth. The artwork showcases detailed etching with crosshatching and fine lines to depict textures and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic, giving a sepia-toned look. A group of figures are on the riverbank, engaged in activities, while others and horses are on the right. The river flows into the distance, leading to hills and mountains. The sky has softly etched clouds, adding openness to the scene.

artworks.title: The Hinny Drover, via Appia
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a rustic path or road. The horizon is visible on the left, where water meets the sky at the shore. A building with smoke billowing from its chimney is nearby. On the right, there are structures, trees, and a taller building. The etched brushwork creates intricate textures and details. The color palette is mainly brown and white. Figures and a horse are seen walking on the path. In the distance, more figures and buildings can be seen along the shoreline.

artworks.title: The Large Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and distant hills. A tall tree stands prominently in the center, with detailed branches. The color scheme is monochrome with tones of sepia and black. A path winds through the vegetation, with figures on horseback and a donkey. More trees and hills are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: The Large Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, revealing distant mountains and hills. Tall trees are centrally located, with detailed brushstrokes creating texture in foliage and rocks. The color scheme is monochromatic using blacks, whites, and grays. A path with figures and a horse is prominent, while a river is visible on the right.

artworks.title: The Ox-Cart: View between Ancona and Sinigaglia
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a countryside scene seen from an elevated angle. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, showing a sky with horizontal brushstrokes indicating clouds and birds flying on the right. On the left are detailed trees, and on the right is a rocky terrain with cliff faces. In the center, a couple walks along a path, one figure holding a staff, heading towards distant structures and cart-drawn animals on the same path. Monochromatic tones balance dark shadows and light highlights in the scene.

artworks.title: The Ponte Molle
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a pastoral scene with an ancient bridge over a river. The composition includes the bridge, river, distant hills, sky, workers, horses, and boats. The lines are precise, defining the textures and figures. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing details and contrast. The scene conveys historical tranquility and timelessness through its rendering of architectural and natural elements.

artworks.title: The Ponte Molle
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river flowing under a stone bridge. There are several figures near the riverbank, including a group of people by boats and someone leading horses towards the bridge. The bridge looks old and partially ruined, possibly overgrown with vegetation. Rolling hills and distant structures are visible on the horizon. The sky is filled with horizontal brush lines resembling clouds. The artwork is monochrome in sepia tones, emphasizing contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Two Cows near the River at Tivoli
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated viewpoint overlooking a calm waterscape and a hill with ruins. The horizon is high in the composition, just below the upper edge of the image, with the ruins and remnants of ancient structures silhouetted against the sky with clouds. The detailed etching style brushstrokes create a textured appearance, especially in the foliage and ruins. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, giving a warm and timeless quality to the scene. In the foreground, a figure sits on an ox-drawn cart by a riverbank with another ox nearby. The landscape gently ascends towards the ruins and distant hills in the background.

artworks.title: The Two Hinnies
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, pack animals, and a figure leading another animal on a path. The scene is depicted with fine etching lines, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray, and there is an interplay of light and shadow emphasizing the rocky cliffs, trees, and terrain.

artworks.title: View of the Tiber in the Campagna
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting a serene landscape. The scene includes figures on horseback, one leading a cow towards a small boat by the water's edge. Tall trees frame the left side, with detailed branches. Rolling hills lead to the distant horizon, where a bridge and structures are faintly visible. The sky has wispy clouds. The composition relies on varying intensities of line work and shading.

artworks.title: View of the Tiber in the Campagna
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. A group of travelers, men, and horses are lined up along a path next to a river. Additional figures are by a small boat on the river. Large trees frame the scene on the left. In the distance, there is a town with buildings and a bridge, surrounded by hills. The sky has wispy clouds, depicted with fine lines. The print is detailed with fine linework in a black and white palette.

artworks.title: The Woman on the Hinny
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a winding path around small cliffs. The horizon is shown with hills and tree lines in the distance. The brushstrokes are detailed and textured, especially in the foliage. The color scheme is mainly shades of brown to black. A rocky path with grass and bushes leads to figures on horseback. Tall trees and clouds are visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Woman on the Hinny
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path winding through dense foliage. The sky is dominated by mountains, trees frame the left side, and more vegetation fills the right. The color scheme is mostly browns and blacks with hints of lighter tones suggesting clouds. A rocky outcrop is in the foreground with figures walking alongside donkeys on the path.

artworks.title: The Wooden Bridge at Sulmona near Tivoli
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective rendered in black and white using intricate etching techniques. The horizon is low, with the sky dominating the top third, filled with clouds defined by horizontal lines. In the foreground, a winding path guides the eye towards a small bridge over a stream, where two figures on horseback are seen. The path leads into a lush landscape with trees and shrubbery, while craggy cliffs rise to the right. The etching uses cross-hatching for depth, particularly in trees and rocks, creating a rich texture. The scene has a monochromatic palette, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Village Road with Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with buildings, including a large gabled house with a thatched roof. Two birds are flying in the sky. The etching uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and shading, with a monochromatic color palette of black on beige paper. Figures and horses are present, appearing to be interacting. Trees frame the structures in the background.

artworks.title: Castle
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a castle with pointed towers and detailed architecture at the center. The horizon is low, emphasizing the castle against the sky with clouds. The artwork features intricate line work to depict the castle and trees, with a monochromatic color scheme of black on cream paper. A path runs by the castle where figures and a dog are seen. Trees in the distance frame the castle.

artworks.title: Castle by a River
artworks.description: The image depicts a large, multi-story castle-like building with elaborate architectural details. Distant hills and trees can be seen in the background. The structure dominates the scene and is created in a style reminiscent of an engraving, with intricate line work and hatching. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. Figures can be seen near the building, including people on horseback and others walking. Smaller structures and trees are visible in the distance, suggesting a rural landscape.

artworks.title: Castle with Lift-Bridge
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a castle positioned to the right from a straight-on perspective. A body of water is seen below the castle, with trees and a bridge in the background. Two birds or ducks are visible on the water. The artwork showcases an etching style with precise lines and cross-hatching, creating texture. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast and historical feel of the scene. More sections of the castle are partially obscured on the right side.

artworks.title: Castle with a Moat
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a medieval scene with a complex landscape. There are hills, trees, and a castle-like structure in the middle. The engraving style is detailed with fine lines, and it is in black and white. Various figures can be seen engaging in daily activities, and there are rolling hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a variety of elements. In the background, there are trees and a house with a thatched roof. In the foreground, there are detailed trees and a pathway. The artwork uses fine lines and cross-hatching for the trees and a uniform shading for the pathway. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark tones. A winding path is depicted with small groups of figures walking or conversing. The composition conveys a peaceful rural scene through intricate etching.

artworks.title: Country House with a Ditch
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a rural scene depicted from a slightly elevated point of view. The view includes a large farmhouse or manor with gabled roofs and chimneys in the distance. Birds can be seen flying over the roof. A line of trees partially obscures the building. A narrow bridge crosses over a water body where cows are resting, reflecting in the water. The artwork uses fine etching lines to create a textured, monochromatic palette that highlights the light and shadow in the scene.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with aerial perspective. The horizon is near the top third, featuring trees and a church with a spire. The etching technique uses fine lines for texture and form, with detailed line work for foliage and architecture. The monochrome palette emphasizes contrast between the sky, clouds, trees, and buildings. A path with small figures leads into the scene, with trees and a woodland on the left. The sky has clouds and birds in flight.

artworks.title: Farmstead
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: This image shows a pastoral scene with a central cluster of buildings surrounded by trees and a wooden fence. A line of trees in the distance indicates the horizon. The artwork is created using fine-line etching, showcasing detailed crosshatching for texture and shading. The monochrome palette of black on a cream background highlights the intricate line work. Cows are seen near a dirt road, while small figures in the distance suggest human activity in the peaceful rural setting.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a thatched-roof building, surrounded by bare trees and sparse vegetation. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a comprehensive view. The horizon line is low, focusing on the building. The image is a detailed etching, depicting the texture of trees, structure, and landscape with intricate lines. The technique creates a monochromatic palette with light and shadow suggested by line density. Near us, two figures stand near cows and a sheep. Further back, another figure walks toward the barn, adding depth. In the upper left, birds hover. The etching is detailed, balancing human elements with nature.
